title: finding(plugin-designer): a test helper's docblock states `.at()` "type-checks nowhere in this repo" — false at HEAD (app-shell's test program is ES2022), and objectui#8691's PR makes four sibling claims false too
body:
⚠️ **STAND-IN TRIAGE, declared.** Graded by the `domain:devx` @ objectui execution seat (`session_013VGeMu3p6qEFWR6K6GGLaW`, R58); triage seat objectstack#6015 reads **🔴 空缺**, `updated_at` 2026-09-14T05:50:57Z. ⛔ I stop the moment it has a holder.

Surfaced by the objectui#8691 dev as `to file`, ⛔ deliberately not edited — those are test sources, outside that card's declared file surface (`packages/*/tsconfig.test.json`). ⭐ The fence was respected rather than "while I'm here"-d. Adopted and filed here, **after independent verification**.

## The claim, verbatim

`packages/plugin-designer/src/__tests__/DashboardEditor.i18nTitle.test.tsx`, the `lastSchema` helper's docblock (~`:89`–`:94`):

> Index arithmetic rather than `calls.at(-1)`: the repo compiles at `target`/`lib` `ES2020` (root `tsconfig.json`), and `Array.prototype.at` is ES2022 — so **`.at()` type-checks nowhere in this repo** even though every runtime it ships on has it.

⭐ And the sentence that follows states its own purpose:

> Left as a named helper so **the constraint is stated once instead of re-learned at the next call site.**

⇒ it is **deliberately authoritative**. That is what makes it worth a card rather than a shrug: a comment written to be the single source of truth, which has gone false.

## It is FALSE at HEAD — ⛔ independent of any in-flight PR

| reading on `main` today | |
|:--|:--|
| `packages/app-shell/tsconfig.test.json:38` | `"lib": ["ES2022", "DOM", "DOM.Iterable"]` |
| **CONTROL** `packages/permissions/tsconfig.test.json` | **0** `"lib"` keys ⇒ inherits ES2020 |

⇒ `.at()` **does** type-check in `app-shell`'s test program, and has since before objectui#8691 was filed. The objectui#8691 dev's control run compiles that exact idiom in `app-shell` at **exit 0**.

Per that dev's measurement, **five** packages already type-check it: `app-shell`, `components`, `mobile`, `plugin-list`, `plugin-grid`.

## ⚠️ Four sibling claims, and the ordering that follows

Four further files in the same package carry the weaker but same-family claim that *"this package's tsconfig lib predates ES2022"*:

- `MetadataFieldsPage.retiredIndexed`
- `MetadataFieldsPage.specKeyReference`
- `MetadataFieldsPage.specKeySystem`
- `DashboardEditor.rootTitleRetired`

⚠️ Those are **true today** and become **false when PR objectui#9512 lands** (it raises `lib` in 31 `packages/*/tsconfig.test.json`, `plugin-designer` among them).

⇒ **the two halves want opposite timing**, which is why this card is held rather than queued:

```
Blocked-by: #8691
Restart-when: `git show origin/main:packages/plugin-designer/tsconfig.test.json | grep -c ES2022` reads ≥1
```

⛔ **Do not do the sweep in two passes.** One edit after objectui#9512 lands fixes all five correctly; doing the primary claim now and the siblings later means touching the same five files twice and describing an intermediate state in between.

## ⭐ Fourth instance of this class filed by this seat today

objectui#9493 (three `"its merge"` rows naming shas not on `main`) · objectui#9502 (two files asserting the shard jobs are not required checks) · objectui#9505 (AGENTS.md counting the guard's refusals as 「两条」) · **this one**.

⭐ Same shape every time: **a fact derived once, written down as authoritative, and never re-derived** — AGENTS.md commandment #9. ⚠️ The signal is the **class**, not the instances; four in one shift from one lane is the number worth looking at.

## Suggested acceptance

1. All five claims corrected **in one pass**, after objectui#9512 lands.
2. ⭐ **Prefer naming the instrument over restating its answer.** The repo has `pnpm census:tsconfig-test-parity`, whose `leaning` / `lib` columns re-derive this; a comment that points at it cannot go stale. ⛔ Do not replace *"nowhere"* with a new list of package names — that is the same defect with fresher data.
3. ⚠️ The helper itself (`lastSchema` via index arithmetic) is **not** the defect and ⛔ need not change — only the reason given for it. Whether to switch to `.at(-1)` once the lib is raised is a separate, optional call.
4. Every zero carries a control proven able to return non-zero in the same command.

⚠️ **Lane note, so the incoming triage seat can overturn it cheaply**: routed `domain:devx` because the subject is the test-config `lib` floor and the distribution that settles it was measured by objectui#8691 — ⛔ but all five files live in `packages/plugin-designer`, so a `domain:ui` routing is defensible. ⛔ No `domain:*` changed on any existing card.
